Every directory under `app/` is a route. A bracketed directory name is a dynamic route, which is a name, not a placeholder.

## Project layout

    app/
    ├─ [slug]/ ❗      the dynamic post route (literal name, instance of
    │                  [route]/)
    │
    └─ [route]/ 0+     a route
       │
       ├─ loading.tsx  the route's loading state
       │
       └─ page.tsx ❗  the route's page

❗ marks a named file or directory that must exist; one without it may be absent. A count after a pattern, such as `0+` or `1+`, is the fewest matching names that must exist.

## `[route]/` — a route

Concrete instances:
- `[slug]/` — the dynamic post route, in `[slug]/AGENTS.MD`

### Adding new instances

A `[route]/` directory needs no declaration. Declaring one gives it its own guidance; see `espalier help instances`.

## `[route]/loading.tsx` — the route's loading state

Renders a skeleton while the route loads.

## `[route]/page.tsx` — the route's page

Default-exports a React component.

## Other repository paths

These paths are part of the repository but serve specific purposes outside the project layout. Use them only for the purpose stated here.

| Paths | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `AGENTS.MD` | Generated repository guidance; edits here will be overwritten. Modify [`ESPALIER.mjs`](../espalier/app/ESPALIER.mjs) to change this document's persistent guidance. |

Every path under app/ must fit the project layout or a documented
repository-specific purpose.
